decisions.quote: The objective of this study was to verify the analysis of Bocquého et al. (2014) and to test the robustness of their results in a replication in 11 European farming systems.
decisions.reason: Both shipped and blind coding agree that the study is a replication collecting new data from 11 European farming systems to re-test Bocquého et al. (2014).

decisions.quote: Bocquého, Géraldine, Florence Jacquet, and Arnaud Reynaud. 2014. “Expected Utility or Prospect Theory Maximisers? Assessing Farmers' Risk Behavior from Field-experiment Data.”
decisions.reason: Both shipped and blind coding identify the same original study by Bocquého, Jacquet, and Reynaud (published online in 2013 with DOI 10.1093/erae/jbt006 and in print in 2014).

decisions.quote: We verified all the analysis using the original code from the authors. We also replicated the original study results in 11 additional samples.
decisions.reason: The authors explicitly conclude that they replicated the original study results across the 11 new samples, confirming risk aversion in gains under EUT, loss aversion (λ > 1) and probability distortion (γ < 1) under CPT, and superior model fit of CPT over EUT; differences in the magnitude of λ and γ parameter estimates across samples reflect effect-size variation rather than a mixed replication outcome.
